verification.probe_failure: observe_future checked only its direct caller. Actual direct caller is asyncpg.connect_utils._create_future, which is called by TLSUpgradeProto.__init__ at the on_data assignment. The filter never matched; no Future identity allocation event exists.
limits: This is the original silent local TCP/asyncpg-only component, not a real PostgreSQL server, SSL handshake completion, pool replacement task, uvloop, Windows or production outage.
